articles.title: Himachal Pradesh High Court Sets Aside ₹1.65 Crore Electricity Assessment For Lack
articles.summary: 65 crore imposed on M/s Sunoxx International for alleged unauthorised use of electricity. The Court held that proceedings under Section 126 of the Electricity Act, 2003, could not be sustained when the Assessing Officer had not inspected the premises and the assessment was initiated on the basis of an audit report and the Electricity Board's records.
articles.title_hi: हिमाचल प्रदेश उच्च न्यायालय ने कमी के लिए ₹1.65 करोड़ बिजली मूल्यांकन रद्द कर दिया
articles.summary_hi: बिजली के कथित अनधिकृत उपयोग के लिए मेसर्स सनॉक्स इंटरनेशनल पर 65 करोड़ रुपये का जुर्माना लगाया गया। न्यायालय ने माना कि विद्युत अधिनियम, 2003 की धारा 126 के तहत कार्यवाही तब तक जारी नहीं रखी जा सकती, जब मूल्यांकन अधिकारी ने परिसर का निरीक्षण नहीं किया था और मूल्यांकन एक ऑडिट रिपोर्ट और बिजली बोर्ड के रिकॉर्ड के आधार पर शुरू किया गया था।
articles.title_hinglish: himachala pradesha uchcha nyayalaya ne kami ke lie ₹1.65 karoda bijali mulyankana radda kara diya
articles.summary_hinglish: bijali ke kathita anadhikrita upayoga ke lie mesarsa sanoksa intaraneshanala para 65 karoda rupaye ka jurmana lagaya gaya। nyayalaya ne mana ki vidyuta adhiniyam, 2003 ki dhara 126 ke tahata karyavahi taba taka jari nahin rakhi ja sakati, jaba mulyankana adhikari ne parisara ka nirikshana nahin kiya tha aura mulyankana eka ऑdita riporta aura bijali borda ke rikorda ke aadhara para shuru kiya gaya tha।

articles.title: AITHP Welcomes Jammu Kashmir Ease of Doing Business Act, Seeks Early Notification of Rules
articles.summary: The Association said the removal of redundant No Objection Certificates (NOCs), repeated clearances and overlapping compliances was essential to allow entrepreneurs to concentrate on production, employment, financing, taxation and marketing rather than spend time pursuing official permissions. “How can enterprises flourish when their owners spend more time pursuing files and permissions than managing and expanding their businesses?”

articles.title: FM Attends World Bank-IMF Annual Meetings, G-20 and G7 Finance Ministers Meet In Bangkok
articles.summary: In her meeting with UK Chancellor of the Exchequer John Healey on the sidelines of the World Bank-IMF annual meetings, Sitharaman discussed the successful conclusion of the fourth India-UK Financial Markets Dialogue, fintech meetings and associated India-UK Financial Partnership (IUKFP) meetings, building on the outcomes of the previous Economic and Financial Dialogue (EFD).
articles.title_hi: वित्त मंत्री ने बैंकॉक में विश्व बैंक-आईएमएफ की वार्षिक बैठक, जी-20 और जी7 वित्त मंत्रियों की बैठक में भाग लिया
articles.summary_hi: विश्व बैंक-आईएमएफ की वार्षिक बैठकों के मौके पर यूके के चांसलर जॉन हेले के साथ अपनी बैठक में, सीतारमण ने पिछले आर्थिक और वित्तीय वार्ता (ईएफडी) के परिणामों के आधार पर चौथे भारत-यूके वित्तीय बाजार संवाद, फिनटेक बैठकों और संबंधित भारत-यूके वित्तीय साझेदारी (आईयूकेएफपी) बैठकों के सफल समापन पर चर्चा की।
articles.title_hinglish: vitta mantri ne bainkoka men vishva bainka-aaeeemaepha ki varshika baithak, ji-20 aura ji7 vitta mantriyon ki baithaka men bhaga liya
articles.summary_hinglish: vishva bainka-aaeeemaepha ki varshika baithakon ke mauke para yuke ke chansalara jona hele ke satha apani baithaka men, sitaramana ne pichhale aarthika aura vittiya varta (eeephadi) ke parinamon ke aadhara para chauthe bharata-yuke vittiya bajara sanvad, phinateka baithakon aura sanbandhita bharata-yuke vittiya sajhedari (aaeeyukeephapi) baithakon ke saphala samapana para charcha ki।

articles.title: PM Modi interacts with Asian Games participants, receives special mementoes
articles.summary: She gifted PM Modi a traditional Manipuri Lengyan, a handwoven loincloth featuring the Sangai deer. Golfer Pranavi Urs, who scripted history by winning India’s first women’s individual golf gold at the Asian Games, presented the Prime Minister with her glove and a golf ball. Recurve archer Kumkum Mohod gifted a wooden bow decorated with shells and other embellishments.
